productionRule: QB adjustment is expected current QB value minus the QB value embedded in the 2025 team baseline, scaled by participation/health/scenario probability. When integrating into the preseason rating, REPLACE the prior manual QB adjustment rather than adding this delta on top of it.

states.reason: Mahomes' 2025 team baseline was depressed by missed time and poor backup play. A fully healthy Mahomes state is +0.70 relative to the embedded baseline, but Week 1 health/mobility probability remains unresolved.
Atlanta's 2025 baseline blended Penix and Cousins. Either current scenario is above that embedded QB state on the calibrated historical scale, but the starter probability is not settled.

Jones is fully cleared, so the prior large injury discount is removed. The calibrated multi-year QB state still regresses his exceptional 2025 performance downward by 0.63 versus Indianapolis' embedded QB baseline.
Baltimore's 2025 QB baseline was depressed by Jackson's leg injuries and backup snaps. His healthy multi-year state is 1.06 points above the embedded baseline.
Cincinnati's 2025 baseline includes extensive Flacco/Browning snaps. Burrow's healthy calibrated state is 0.93 points better than the team QB state embedded in 2025.
Tampa Bay's 2025 team QB state was materially below Mayfield's multi-year calibrated level, producing a +0.76 forward QB correction.
Miami released Tua and installed Willis. Willis lacks a qualifying calibrated sample, so the model does not invent a point value; a small-sample prior is still required.
Las Vegas' 2025 QB state was deeply negative. Cousins provides a calibrated +1.60 transition versus that embedded baseline and is the heavy favorite to start over Fernando Mendoza.

Cleveland's embedded 2025 QB baseline is already extremely poor. The current Watson/Sanders competition is unresolved and neither has a defensible calibrated current PAR, so no arbitrary adjustment is assigned.
Rodgers was already the dominant Pittsburgh QB in the 2025 baseline. His multi-year current calibration is 0.44 points below the embedded 2025 QB state, so no new-star premium is appropriate.
The Jets' 2025 QB room was one of the league's weakest. Geno Smith's calibrated state represents a +1.34 point transition from that embedded baseline.
Murray has been named Minnesota's Week 1 starter. The 2025 Vikings QB carousel embedded a -0.99 PAR state; Murray's calibrated historical state is +0.82, a +1.81 transition.
Arizona moved on from Kyler Murray and is currently structured around Brissett. His calibrated state is 0.68 points below the 2025 team QB state.
The Chargers' 2025 QB state was depressed by Herbert's difficult season and backup snaps. His calibrated multi-year state is +0.54 versus the embedded baseline.
